findings: The frozen repository source is an exact singleton Question identifying Delete Duplicates from Sorted List II / LeetCode 82; Java node shape, null handling, allocation and mutation policy are not preserved source constraints.
The candidate labels those API/ownership choices as answer-side contracts rather than source facts.

The previous review attempt exposed a real repository-gate defect: the Java fence had top-level members and failed the repository Java audit. The remediated candidate is now a standalone Solution class and compiles without reviewer wrapping.
The algorithm correctly exploits sorted-run contiguity: duplicated runs leave prev fixed and reconnect prev.next after the full run, while singleton runs advance prev.

An independently authored oracle compiles the exact candidate and checks 11,440 exhaustive sorted inputs, 25,000 deterministic random cases, exact original-node identity, acyclic output and a 200,000-node large case.
The answer distinguishes LeetCode 82 from 83, states the sorted-input prerequisite, explains O(n) via monotonic pointer movement and does not fabricate project experience.
